meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会多一个 WhatsApp 收发消息入口。它会先询问你使用专用号还是常用号，再完成安装适配器与验证，并让你扫码或输配对码绑定。常用号模式下，它只在你自己的聊天里出现，不读别人消息。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 WhatsApp 频道，或要求把 NanoClaw 连上 WhatsApp 时触发。触发后先做号码安全确认，再进入安装步骤。

say.text: 帮我添加 WhatsApp 频道。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行安全检查和接入流程。

say.text: 我想用自己的常用号码接 WhatsApp。
say.note: 会先显示共享号码风险提醒并请你确认。

say.text: 用配对码方式连接 WhatsApp。
say.note: 需要你提供手机号并按提示输码。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can chat via WhatsApp. It asks which number to use, copies the adapter, then links by QR or pairing code. Shared numbers only use self-chat; others' messages are ignored.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel or connect NanoClaw to WhatsApp. It first checks which number you'll use, then proceeds with setup.

say_en.note: Claude will start the safety check and setup.

say_en.text: I want to link WhatsApp with my everyday number.
say_en.note: A shared-number risk warning will appear first.
You'll need to provide your phone number to continue.
